data.name: Arkaan
data.long_meaning: Arkaan is a name of Arabic origin, derived from the Arabic word 'arkan' which means 'foundation' or 'base'. In Islamic context, Arkaan represents the one who lays the foundation of faith and righteousness. It is a name for a boy, symbolizing strength, protection, and a steadfast commitment to Islamic values.
